Practised decade, century and millennium terms and identifying a year’s century.
Aarav practised using century ranges such as 1901–2000 and 1801–1900.
They repeatedly used the first two digits to name a century, including for 1947 and 1857.
The mix-up remained at the last check; next time, revisit that years ending in 00 belong to the preceding century.
end.parentNote: Asha practised century ranges with Aarav, including 1901–2000 and 1801–1900. They used the range method briefly for 1947, but later returned to using the first two digits, so this mix-up was not corrected at the end. At home, ask Aarav to place years such as 101, 100, 1857 and 1947 into century ranges before naming each century.
